metadata.notes: Added supplementary_heating_system_first complex mapping for T5_R30_C1/C2. Extracts fuel source and equipment type from first supplementary heating system (fireplaces, wood stoves, etc.). Returns 'None' when no supplementary systems present. Now 84 fields extracted from H2K files (vs 53 placeholders).

fdwr_calculation.description: Calculate fenestration and door to wall ratio as percentage
fdwr_calculation.calculation: ((window_se + window_ne + window_nw + window_sw + window_s + window_n + window_e + window_w + door_main + door_basement) / (wall_main + wall_basement_above)) * 100 if (wall_main + wall_basement_above) > 0 else 0

total_window_door_area.description: Calculate total fenestration and door area in mÂ² (includes main floor and basement windows/doors)
total_window_door_area.calculation: window_se + window_ne + window_nw + window_sw + window_s + window_n + window_e + window_w + door_main + door_basement + basement_window_se + basement_window_ne + basement_window_nw + basement_window_sw + basement_window_s + basement_window_n + basement_window_e + basement_window_w

ventilation_power.description: Calculate ventilation fan power in W/L/s

gross_wall_area.description: Calculate total above-grade wall area in m² (includes pony walls, main walls, basement above-grade, floor headers, and crawlspace walls)
gross_wall_area.calculation: pony_wall + main_walls + basement_above_grade + basement_floor_header + crawlspace_wall + crawlspace_floor_header

fdwr_percentage_comprehensive.description: Calculate FDWR percentage (fenestration and door to wall ratio) as (total fenestration area / gross wall area) * 100
fdwr_percentage_comprehensive.calculation: ((window_se + window_ne + window_nw + window_sw + window_s + window_n + window_e + window_w + door_main + door_basement + basement_window_se + basement_window_ne + basement_window_nw + basement_window_sw + basement_window_s + basement_window_n + basement_window_e + basement_window_w) / (pony_wall + main_walls + basement_above_grade + basement_floor_header + crawlspace_wall + crawlspace_floor_header)) * 100 if (pony_wall + main_walls + basement_above_grade + basement_floor_header + crawlspace_wall + crawlspace_floor_header) > 0 else 0
